title: b7z9.37.1(i): root-sig DIO option wire format in message.rs (OPT 0x17 provisional)
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.1. message.rs: add OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE = 0x17 (provisional — spec/06 8.10.1 says 'type TBD'; follows the provisional 0x12 DAO-origin / 0x16 version-auth pattern; MUST be kept in sync with the C child b7z9.37.2). Variable-length option carrying the COSE_Sign1 blob (vectors: ~100 bytes; RPL option length u8 caps at 255 — enforce a max). Mirror the DaoOriginSignature pattern: from_bytes with min/over-length rejection, write_to with BufferTooSmall, tests: byte-exact round-trip using the committed vector cose_sign1 (root_dio_signature.json case root_dio_signature_valid_basic, external oracle), too-short, over-max, buffer-too-small. If the DIO option loop rejects unknown options, register the type there; if it skips unknowns, standalone slice stands.
